questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: The distance travelled by a particle starting from rest and moving with an acceleration $\frac{4}{3} \mathrm{ ms}^{-2}, in the third second is:$
questions.solution:
Distance travelled in the $n$th second is given by $d_n=u+\frac{a}{2}(2 n-1) \begin{aligned}& \text{ put } \mathrm{u}=0, \mathrm{a}=\frac{4}{3} \mathrm{ ms}^{-2}, \mathrm{n}=3 \\ \text{$ and $} \therefore \mathrm{d}=0+\frac{4}{3 \times 2}(2 \times3-1)=\frac{4}{6} \times5=\frac{10}{3} \mathrm{ m}
\end{aligned}$

questions.q: The velocity-time graph of a body moving in a straight line is shown in fig. Find the displacement and distance travelled by the body in 10 seconds.
questions.solution: Total distance covered in $10 \mathrm{ s}=$ Area $1+$ Area $2+$ Area 3 \Rightarrow $\frac{1}{2} \times6 \times20+\frac{1}{2} \times2 \times20+\frac{1}{2} \times2 \times10=90 \mathrm{ m}$ Total displacement in $10 \mathrm{ s}=$ Area $1-$ Area 2 + Area 3 \Rightarrow $\frac{1}{2} \times6 \times20-\frac{1}{2} \times2 \times20+\frac{1}{2} \times2 \times10=50 \mathrm{ m}$
